meta.transfer_rule: A succession link counts as a transfer only when continuiteEconomique is true, both establishments are in the mapped Paris food set, the successor registration date is within ±60 days of the predecessor closure date, and the two points are within 100 m. Only that predecessor closure and successor opening are removed from event counts.
meta.age_stats_note: median_age_years and share_of_stock_under_3y count only establishments with known dateCreationEtablissement; placeholder-dated venues stay in active_now and rate denominators.
meta.partial_month_rule: release month flagged is_partial; months after ANALYSIS_END flagged is_provisional
meta.active_stock_definition: Registry etat A at snapshot; closures on/before date remove stock; known opening date must be on/before date; placeholder opening dates count from release snapshot only.

moments.sentence: Highest city-wide openings in the pulse window: 3,192 in 2024.
Lowest city-wide openings in the pulse window: 2,161 in 2020.
Largest year-on-year opening drop city-wide: -902 (-29.4%) from 2019 to 2020, led by Traditional restaurant (-434); every eligible format fell.
Largest year-on-year rise in closures: 499 (+28.7%) from 2022 to 2023.
Largest year-on-year drop in closures: -229 (-9.5%) from 2024 to 2025.
Traditional restaurant share of city openings moved from 44.7% to 38.3% of openings, 2019 to 2025 (-6.4 pp).

Across all formats (2024-07-01 … 2026-06-30), net rates range from 20th arrondissement at 0.1 to 8th arrondissement at 11.4 per 100 active (city stock-weighted 4.7); 0 of 20 arrondissements had net closures.
